To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

“The InterDataNet architecture provides an innovative and viable solution to the problem of creating a trusted and personalized management of e-Profilers’ data, thus enabling the delivery of trusted e-Services to the end users”.
the InterDataNet approach can enable a new generation of e-Services that are more personalized and more trusted.
the e-Profile Management as Horizontal Service for the creation of specialized e-Services, is a promising approach for the development of new and innovative e-Services.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a Web-based e-Profile Management System (ePMS) that enables the provision of trusted e-Services, and in particular e-Health services.

(a) the development of a Web-based trust management of e-Proﬁles to third party generic providers, and (b) the development of an e-Service framework for the creation of specialized e-Services, which are personalized and trusted by means of e-Proﬂles.

the creation of a new e-Service category, the so called InterDataNet Services (IDS), that will provide e-Service Providers with the possibility to create, access, manage and deliver personalized services to their customers, based on their e-Profile.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

InterDataNet can represent a viable and innovative approach for the creation and management of e-Profile, thus supporting the creation of a new generation of e-Services, which will be able to provide the right level of trust to the users, while maximizing the reuse of the data.
the InterDataNet architecture can be seen as a viable and effective solution to the problem of e-Profile management as a basic horizontal service for the creation of specialized e-Services.

, the InterDataNet approach is a viable solution to the challenge of e-Profiles management, and that it can provide an effective support to the creation of new e-Services, thus contributing to the Service Science and Management fields, and to the Service Engineering discipline as well.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the InterDataNet architecture, in the context of e-Service provision and consumption, is a viable and promising solution to enable the creation and management of e-Profilers and e-Service Providers’ trust, in a way that would support the development of innovative e-Services.
we aim to create an e-Space where the e-Profiles are managed as the basic horizontal service to support the creation of specialized e-Services.

InterDataNet is an innovative and alternative approach to e-Profiles management, that can provide a Web-based trust enabling management of e-Profile to third party generic Service Providers to support access to and delivery of trusted personalized services.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the InterDataNet architecture has the potential to provide a new way for e-Service Providers and Netizens to create and manage their own e-Profiles and to use them in a trusted and personalized way, with the aim to increase the quality of the Netizens’ experience in the e-Services consumption.
a Web-based trust-enabled e-Profile management can be a basic horizontal service for the creation of specialized e-services.

the InterDataNet architecture, by providing a basic horizontal service to create and manage personalized e-Profiles, can be a viable solution to overcome the chasm between data openness and data security, and thus can be a powerful tool for the creation of specialized e-Services.
